name: Pump SMG
summary: Compact machine pistol with high fire rate. Seen wielded by Boobie Ike's crew in indoor confrontation scenes from Trailer 2.
description: The Pump SMG is a compact submachine gun inspired by the MP5K, featuring a folding stock, 30-round magazine, and an extremely high cyclic rate of fire. Seen in Trailer 2 wielded by members of Boobie Ike's crew during indoor confrontation sequences, its small profile makes it ideal for close-quarters combat while remaining concealable under clothing.

seo.description: Complete profile of the Pump SMG in GTA VI. Fire rate, damage, and where to find this compact machine pistol used by Boobie Ike's crew.
